description: This article reviews key techniques for compressing embedding models, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, low-rank approximation, parameter sharing, sparse embeddings, and weight clustering, all aimed at reducing model size and computational demands while maintaining performance. title: dimensionality-reduction-need-and-approaches

title: Unlocking the Power of Embeddings in NLP Systems

title: "Unveiling the Ethical Dilemmas in NLP Embeddings Usage"

title: Embeddings: Transforming AI and NLP Forever
description: Embeddings are mathematical representations that revolutionize AI by capturing semantic relationships, evolving from one-hot encoding to advanced models like Word2Vec, GloVe, and BERT. title: Demystifying Embedding Models in Machine Learning
description: Embedding models are machine learning algorithms that convert complex data like text, images, or audio into dense numerical vectors, capturing semantic and contextual relationships.
